title: Research Rerun camera frustum coordinate setup
objective: Determine the correct Rerun Python logging pattern for a world-frame camera pose, visible camera frustum, and projected image plane, including the correct ViewCoordinates and Transform3D matrix convention for an Unreal/SPEAR camera.
instructions: Use primary Rerun documentation/API references where possible and inspect examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py.

Answer whether the camera entity should log ViewCoordinates.RDF or similar at the camera path, how Transform3D mat3x3 is interpreted, and how to attach RGB/depth images so the 3D origin/frustum is correct.
Also assess why spear/images albedo/normals may look like weird colors and whether non-RGB modalities should be visualized differently or named more explicitly.
expected_outputs: Concrete implementation recommendation with exact Rerun paths/archetypes and coordinate convention.
Any likely color-channel corrections for RGB/albedo/normals called out separately.
definition_of_done: Builder can implement without further decisions.
